summary: Transform your career with our Business Analytics course tailored for non-technical professionals. Learn to analyze data and make informed business decisions.
lede: Business Analytics for Non-Technical Professionals helps you turn everyday data into clearer, more confident decisions without requiring coding, a statistics background, or technical expertise. You will learn to read data, recognize trends and patterns, and interpret dashboards in a practical business context. The course also shows you how to question assumptions, communicate insights clearly, and connect findings to action. Use these skills to contribute to performance discussions, evaluate team results, forecast demand, and understand customer behavior.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across various sectors who are keen to enhance their decision-making with data-driven insights. If you are responsible for making strategic decisions or contributing to performance evaluations, this course is for you.
audience: Public sector officers using dashboards for policy
modules: Converting Business Questions into Data Questions
Business Analytics for Planning and Strategy
Analytics in the Public, Private, and NGO Sectors
prerequisites: No prior technical experience is required. Basic familiarity with office software (e.g., spreadsheets) is beneficial.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
